text:
Instruments
Technical Procedure
Equipment
 Digital Energy Meter
 All Types
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, to be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The
testing procedure for all types of energy meters for 500kv, 132kv units and 
lines
The 
first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ahmad Mohamed Hamada, 
accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Diaa El-Gabalawe, revised by 
eng. Kamel Ragheb: 
HPGC general director 
quality control, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zaid 
Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station,
Safety Precautions
The 
 Unit or Line meters under test must be out of service.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Maintenance 
 staff should be trained well, qualified or directly supervised by some one 
 who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal
 safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... 
 etc
The 
 Unit or Line meters under test must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multimeter
Meter test PTS 1.3
Test stand
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Short circuit the current terminals and open voltage terminals which feed 
 the meter
Be sure there is no voltage at meter terminals using multimeter.
Disconnect meter wires and isolate them with tape.
Remove the meter from the panel and take it to the lab.
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of attached test certificate
Short circuit the current terminals and open voltage terminals which feed 
 the meter
Be sure there is no voltage at meter terminals using multimeter.
Disconnect meter wires and isolate them with tape.
Remove the meter from the panel and take it to the lab.
Testing Procedures
Put the meter at test stand.
Measure the meter insulation at 100v.
Connect the meter terminals to the meter test PTS1.3 as shown at figure 1
Connect the scanning head between the meter and meter test.
Switch power on to the meter test.
Adjust meter test to measurement function and select "error measure' mode.
From sub menu:
Select 4 wire measurement.
Select watt measurement.
Enter meter constant.
Enter number of pulses
Select 4 wire measurement.
Select watt measurement.
Enter meter constant.
Enter number of pulses
Adjust the voltage at 100v.
Inject current and adjust the scanning head.
Adjust pf =1.0
Adjust the current at 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100% of load current.
Measure the error.
Record the readings at the attached test certificate
Adjust pf = 0.5
Repeat steps 11, 12, 13.
Be sure the error at acceptable limits.
Return the Meter to 
Service
Switch power off.
Disconnect the meter terminals 
 from meter test.
Measure the meter insulation at 
 1000v.
Return the meter to the panel 
 at site.
Connect meter wires.
Disconnect the SC and close the 
 voltage circuits.
Place a 
 copy of test results in the field maintenance file.
